Cut the night short and you cut the handover short too.

prompt: what is confirmation bias
reply:
It is the habit of noticing evidence that agrees with you and skating past evidence that does not. Convinced a teacher dislikes you? Every frown gets filed and every ordinary moment gets dropped. 🔍 The fix is not trying harder to be neutral — it is deliberately hunting for the strongest case against your own view first.

prompt: what does correlation is not causation mean
reply:
Two things moving together does not prove one caused the other. Among children, bigger feet go with better reading — shoe size is not teaching anyone, being older explains both. 👣 That hidden third factor is called a confounder. So when a headline says X causes Y, ask what else could be moving both.

[QUIZ]Ice cream sales and sunburn rise together — what is the hidden factor?[/QUIZ]

[FACT]Psychologists call the time lost when you swap between tasks a switch cost.[/FACT]
